findings.issue: The migration candidate is appended with requiredOnSuccess=true and no result selector/variant. The migration target schema and transformation slots are optional for the existing compiler operation, so this declares the migration candidate as a mandatory output for ordinary non-migration compilation too. The existing handoff contract requires exact result variants and selectors to preserve output distinctions; the current proposal does not make this output conditional on an exact supported migration request.
findings.correction: Represent the migration candidate as a conditional success result selected only when both exact migration inputs are supplied and the declared transformation is supported. Preserve the existing normalized graph/project-plan output for ordinary compilation, and make AC-14's UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED branch return no migration candidate. Bind any output variant to its exact selector and result meaning under the existing output-variant convention.
findings.acceptance: A request with no migration inputs can succeed with the existing normalized semantic graph/project-plan candidate and does not require a migration artifact; a supported complete migration request produces the version-bound migration candidate and semantic diff; unsupported/lossy/ambiguous/unknown or partial migration input produces explicit UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED with no migration candidate or effect.
